query:
insert into RequirementReplacements (
                        last_collect_nr,
                        product_id,
                        req_id,
                        replaced_req_id
                    )
                    values (
                        $1,
                        $2,
                        $3,
                        $4
                    )
                    on conflict (product_id, req_id, replaced_req_id)
                    do update set
                        last_collect_nr = excluded.last_collect_nr
